Name: (AT)Chair to NPC Furniture by AYMDuck
Author: AYMduck
Description:
[size=4]通过简单的[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Texture[/url]魔法让村民“来到”屋子里✌️[/size]
[size=3]
为了方便更换贴图选定了家具里面种类最多的椅子，可能不是最适合的（因为不小心坐上去就会穿模……），但是相对来说最方便分类和寻找~可以自行改为太阳能板/稻草人等两格高的物品贴图

推荐配合[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19675]Happy Home Designer[/url]使用，预览很方便~[/size]

With a simple [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]AT[/url]﻿ magic spell, the villagers "appeared" inside the house✌️

To make it easier to change the texture, the chair with the largest variety of types was selected from the furniture. It might not be the most suitable one (because if you accidentally sit on it, you'll get a distorted image...), but it is relatively the most convenient for classification and searching.

You can freely change it to the texture of solar panels or scarecrows (items of two-grid height) at will. 

It is recommended to use it in conjunction with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19675]Happy Home Designer[/url]﻿, for the preview function is very convenient!
